identity.label: Archetypal character arcs
identity.summary: Story-development skill for designing life-cycle archetypal arcs, shadow temptations, flat impact roles, and initiatory structural beats without reducing characters to fixed labels.

memory_routing: Use for author-support outlining, arc diagnosis, romance-lead design, antagonist pressure, and prompt-pack scaffolding rather than direct live-scene control.
Route accepted archetypal role, Lie, Truth, shadow pressure, and impact role to Character Book.
Route active thresholds, symbolic tests, pinch points, false victories, and death/rebirth beats to Scenario Book.
Route proof of growth, refusal, regression, sacrifice, and shadow temptation to Memory Book when the author saves them.

guardrails: Do not force a character into an archetype because of age, gender, role title, or relationship status.
Do not reduce a character to a single label; preserve motive, contradiction, flaw, agency, and context.
Do not treat shadow archetypes as automatic villainy; they are pressure patterns, tragic temptations, or refusal modes.
Do not overwrite {{user}}'s inner life, choices, feelings, or final transformation unless the user explicitly asks for authoring or impersonation support.
Do not dump archetype theory into scene prose.
